Same-origin policy

An origin is a scheme, host and port combination. The same-origin policy restricts many cross-origin reads;
CORS can allow specified cross-origin HTTP reads.

Interview question: Does same-origin policy stop all cross-origin requests?

Answer: No. It restricts access to cross-origin resources; some requests can still be sent, and CORS can
permit reads.
